text:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a p95 regression on canary h100 after yesterday's kernel-router tweak. Triton path is falling back to CUTLASS frequently for seq=128-256, p95 ~+30ms. Any quick thoughts?
aj: Confirmed on canary-7, same window. Batch sizes 1-4 show p95 jump. Throughput stable but latency tail up. :thinking:
liam: Dumped profiler samples — looks like workspace allocs are failing intermittently and triton selector opts out. Snippet:```
E cuMemAlloc(ptr=0x7f8b...): out of memory
[triton_selector] workspace_req=12MB available=10MB -> fallback to cutlass (2/100 samples)
```
sophia: That sounds like the probe sampler change from last week, we lowered the probe sample size and shortened hysteresis. Might be flipping kernels too often during warm KV-cache churn.
maria: Are we also seeing KV-cache hit-rate changes when the kernel flips?
aj: Yes — I noticed a ~2.5% drop in kv-hit around the same time window. Might be transient but correlates with fallback events. Could be format/layout mismatch causing cache invalidation.
liam: Related profiler note: when we fall back to CUTLASS we also change the KV layout padding for streaming cache; that triggers extra cold lookups for a few requests. I can repro locally with:```
python -m perf.cli --model redwood-7b --seq 192 --warmups 50 --iters 200 --routing probe
```
aj: Current selector config (canary):```
kernel_selector:
  probe_threshold: 0.55
  fallback_hysteresis_ms: 50
  small_workspace_fallback: true
  prefer_triton_seq_cutoff: 64
```
aj: Quick mitigation I tried: bump fallback_hysteresis_ms -> 200 and disable small_workspace_fallback. Results — p95 back near baseline, throughput down ~3%.
sophia: We should change autotune logic: prefer Triton for seq <=256 on H100 unless memfail_rate > 1% over last 1m. And add a KV-affinity safety: if kv-hit drops >3% in 2m, force rollback to previous kernel.
maria: Agreed. Also want a unit test to catch KV-format incompatibility when swapping kernels. Add an integration perf test that flips kernels mid-warmup and asserts kv-hit doesn't drop >1%.
aj: I'll open a PR for selector tweaks + test. Will include perf artifacts. Posting graphs in comments: https://internal/graphs/1987654321
deploy-bot: rollback: kernel-router v1.12 -> v1.11 at 1987654330 (auto-rollback due to latency-slo breach).
perf-bot: perf-alert: p95 regression (canary-h100) resolved after rollback.
maria: Nice work all, please link the PR and add a short postmortem note to eng-runtime/notes. :thumbsup:
